*'''xmlset_roodkcableoj28840ybtide''' is a known backdoor on some '''[[Alpha Networks]]''' :(originally '''[[D-Link]]''''s R&D + manufacturing division, [http://www.alphanetworks.com/_english/06_about/00_overview.php?appid=71 they spun off in 2003]) manufactured products.
*It is enough to change browser’s user agent string to “xmlset_roodkcableoj28840ybtide” (no quotes), :to access the web interface without any authentication and view/change the device settings. :If you read this string backwards you will get: ''edit by 048820 joel backdoor''.
*More information is available on [http://www.devttys0.com/2013/10/reverse-engineering-a-d-link-backdoor/ '''/dev/ttyS0''' (''Reverse Engineering a D-Link Backdoor'')].
===Affected devices=== Affected devices would all seem to be using [[Realtek]] RTL86xx SoCs.
====Confirmed==== *[[D-Link DIR-100 rev A]] - [http://www.devttys0.com/2013/10/reverse-engineering-a-d-link-backdoor/ first noted affected device on ''Craig'''s post] *[[D-Link TM-G5240]] (FW ver: v4.0.0b29) - tested by [[User:M86|M86]]
====Possibly (via [http://www.shodanhq.com/search?q=thttpd-alphanetworks%2F2.23 ''Shodan'' search for the thttpd build used])==== *[[D-Link DIR-120 rev A1]] *[[D-Link DI-624S rev B1]] *[[D-Link DI-524UP]] *[[D-Link DI-604S]] *[[D-Link DI-604UP]] *[[D-Link DI-604+]] *[[Planex BRL-04R]] (likely) *[[Planex BRL-04UR]] (likely) *[[Planex BRL-04CW]] *[[Planex BRL-04CW-U]] (likely) ===Known Alpha RTL86xx devices in the DB=== {{#ask: [[Manuf::Alpha Networks]] [[CPU1 model::~RTL86*]] | ?Embedded system type = Type | ?CPU1 model | ?FLA1 amount = Flash | ?RAM1 amount = RAM | ?Expansion IFs | ?WI1 chip1 model=WI1 model | ?Default IP address = Default IP | ?Default login user = Default user | ?Default login pass = Default pass | format = broadtable }}
